newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate surges on Brazil woes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate surges on Brazil woes.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates eased off earlier levels but still closed up 75 basis points on Friday due to nervousness over a weak peso and falling equity prices in Brazil.
"The market stumbled again today, and was tripped up by jitters over Brazilian stock markets and a volatile peso," a fixed-income analyst said.
The Bovespa index of blue chips traded in Sao Paulo fell 4.5 percent to 11,201 points.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts ended 4.5 centavos weaker at 7.8990/7.9040 per dollar.
